summary: Successful fifteen years of experience in IT Management and Technical Support. Skilled in installation, configuration, migration and implementation of server platforms. Dedicated IT Manager well‑versed in analyzing and mitigating risk, finding cost‑effective solutions, strategic planning, designing and budgeting for new products. Excellent troubleshooting skills in network, servers and software applications.

experience.title: Information Technology Manager
responsibilities: Provided leadership, vision and management to the IT department.
Developed and monitored the capital budget and approved department expenditures.
Managed, monitored and maintained network infrastructure and phone system.
Oversaw hardware and software configuration, installation and maintenance.
Managed IT staff scheduling, performance reviews, training, hiring and disciplinary actions.
Maintained PCI DSS compliance and managed technology documents, maintenance agreements and service contracts.
Researched new technologies and performed capacity planning.
Improved business processes through technical analysis to save cost and time.

experience.title: Computer Manufacturing Supervisor
responsibilities: Supervised a team of 25 assemblers, 3 testers and 6 technicians.
Organized daily computer assembly and testing for production.
Implemented safety, performance and policy procedures.
Ensured employee training and monitored software/hardware compatibility.
Managed documentation control for all hardware and software.
Coordinated issue resolution and effective communication with engineering, logistics and management.

experience.title: Quality Assurance Supervisor
responsibilities: Supervised a team of 15 quality inspectors and 8 software evaluators.
Hired, interviewed and promoted candidates for new positions.
Coordinated quality assurance for new product development and prototypes.
Monitored software/hardware compatibility and reliability.
Managed documentation control and vendor evaluations.
Counseled employees to improve morale, productivity and teamwork.
Implemented ISO 9000 compliance procedures and safety policies.

projects.name: PCI Data Security Standard Compliance
projects.description: Guided the company to comply with PCI DSS and achieved certification.

projects.name: Analog Phone System to VOIP Migration
projects.description: Migrated the analog phone system to VOIP, saving over $40k per year.

projects.name: Physical Server Migration to Hyper‑V
projects.description: Migrated 80% of physical servers to Hyper‑V to reduce costs and improve productivity.
